_doc: Review layer (DOC-3D-MAPPING: 'never silently guess identity'). Applied after automatic extraction + VLM labelling. Entries were made by the build team from a visual check of rendered crops (AI-assisted), not by a person in the field; outputs are tagged label_source='review-corrected'. Regions are in the canonical scene frame (metres, +Y up), so they survive pipeline re-runs.
_demo_start_doc: Robot dock (x, z in the canonical frame). Pinned so the start does not move when the target's binding changes; without it the start is the drivable cell farthest from the target.
